tagline: A mega-capital, the Thousand Islands, and a cross-border triangle to Singapore.
summary: Jakarta pairs a congested coastal mega-capital with the Thousand Islands (Kepulauan Seribu) resort archipelago just offshore, while Batam sits on the high-frequency Singapore–Batam–Bintan cross-border triangle. Pioneer II suits the Thousand Islands and inner-harbour hops; Quanta-LR's hybrid range strengthens the cross-border and inter-island corridors.
